newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices rise on world recovery.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices rise on world recovery.

text.p: India copper prices bounced back from reduced levels on Friday while other base metals were unchanged, dealers said.

Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,400 rupees per quintal on restricted supplies and fresh industrial support. Copper was down by 100 rupees on Thursday. Reports of recovery in the world market also triggered speculative buying.
Nickel was steady at 36,200 rupees per quintal on fresh physical support. It was down by 300 rupees on Thursday.
Zinc was unchanged at 6,450 rupees per quintal, lead at 4,400 and aluminium at 7,200. Tin traded at the previous level of 34,300 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
